title: DefaultVerifier P-384 limitation not documented
description: pkix-path v0.1 DefaultVerifier only supports RSA-SHA256 and ECDSA-P-256-SHA256. P-384 CA chains (ecdsa-with-SHA384) will produce a generic SignatureInvalid or Other error with no explanation. Users with P-384 hierarchies will be confused. Fix: add a doc comment or warning in validate_chain noting this limitation.
